nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic video data and volume measurements from a freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, used to calibrate simulation parameters for driving behaviors.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability statement specifies that the data used to support the results are available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: The simulation parameters regarding driving behaviors are calibrated based on empirical data.
nodes_process.description: Initialize a virtual environment mirroring the Qingdao-Huangdao freeway mainline and merge zone. Configure simulation boundaries including fixed limits for maximum travel velocity on ramp vs mainline, using field-calibrated behavior templates for time step integration.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, simulator named, core speed limits given, but minor behavioral model defaults in SUMO are implied without strict listing.

nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive observations are stacked to represent the traffic state.
nodes_process.description: Construct discrete spatial-coordinate matrices mapping identified vehicle coordinates into boolean tensors. Combine zooming and spatial down-sampling protocols to trim input resolution, cascading 3 consecutive localized tensors into multidimensional inputs.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, required techniques are trivial matrix ops, and every target dimensional parameter (4x512 with 3 channels) is cleanly quantified.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network in Mnih et al. [30] is revised as Figure 7, which consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer
nodes_process.description: Specify the layout of a parallel deep neural agent capable of feature generation and bifurcated predictions. Define consecutive sequential convolutional grids terminating in ReLU non-linearities, fully connected towards predicting raw state action utilities alongside secondary tasks like local delay or traffic speed approximation.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, fully stated explicit CNN filter footprints, exact stride patterns, layer combinations, output neurons count, and activation strategy (ReLu) depicted openly in fig 7.

nodes_process.source_quote: The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update wi to minimize the loss function.
nodes_process.description: Engage stochastic policy development over simulation time leveraging an eps-greedy scheme to aggregate step transitions inside replay buffer. Enforce target parameter copy intervals stabilizing the temporal difference updates under a hybrid loss scaling formulation using a gradient tracking mechanism.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, lists exactly all pivotal hyperparameters needed (buffer sizes, step size constraints, target net sync frequencies) and outlines pseudo-code properly with optimization technique.

nodes_process.source_quote: KR = 90 and KP = 50 are two regulator parameters in PI-ALINEA, which are fine-tuned to minimize mean travel times in the traffic system.
nodes_process.description: Adapt classic baseline metering heuristics operating purely via fixed threshold comparisons, tailoring feedback regulator scales corresponding precisely to system constraints over target occupancy density thresholds natively.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, lists complete operational update dynamics in an exact mathematical function tied tightly to parameter targets.

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments. The simulations for the training phase and each experiment are initialized with different random seeds.
nodes_process.description: Process distinct control logic streams per experiment mapping metrics matching velocity, local accumulation arrays, throughput constraints and latency logs inside fixed interval bounds comparing no-system interference directly vs deployed baselines logic against experimental DRL logic over numerous repeated trials under shifting random variable seeding.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, strictly documented evaluation protocol isolating independent randomness trials using cleanly stated count arrays. Metric mapping variables clear.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data. As shown in Figure 15, the control area is divided into eight subareas.
nodes_process.description: Inject structured occlusion testing frameworks blanking inputs strictly per pre-mapped segmented geographic visual subzones artificially, capturing latency deltas reflecting operational deterioration under degraded data streaming bounds against initial normal output baseline curves sequentially to measure controller data resilience.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, missing specific coordinate bounding logic framing the arbitrary subareas but experimental logic repeats cleanly.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 8: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Convergence plots over training frames for episode reward and mean travel time, illustrating the learning stability and efficiency.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Empirical traffic data for simulation available only upon request; algorithm architecture and hyperparameters are well detailed. Simulation uses open-source SUMO.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9: Vehicle travel times in the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Plots the median vehicle travel times along with interquartile ranges over the simulation period for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL strategies.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Empirical traffic data for simulation available only upon request; algorithm architecture and hyperparameters are well detailed. Simulation uses open-source SUMO.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2: Mean travel times in 20 simulation experiments (s).
nodes_sink.description: Table reporting the mean travel times in seconds and percentage changes across 20 distinct simulation scenarios with different initializations for three strategies.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Data is available on request, limiting fully independent run-from-scratch replication, but SUMO usage and algorithm specs enable reproduction if data were acquired.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in (a) no-control; (b) PI-ALINEA; (c) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Contour diagrams of mainline speed over time and distance space to evaluate mitigation of massive merging congestion and performance of metering.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Original data not strictly public; underlying methods to yield outputs are comprehensively modeled and defined via standard equations and deep RL hyper-parameters.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11: Queue length at the on-ramp.
nodes_sink.description: Line plots detailing on-ramp queue formation and dispersal through time showing percentiles for DRL compared to PI-ALINEA and a no-control baseline.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Empirical input data is closed without explicit request; methodologies follow standardized simulator workflows that align well with drawn plots.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Scatter charts correlating the queue length to signal cycle red-phase duration ratio, exhibiting strategy efficiency on green-light exploitation.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulated evaluation metrics cleanly justify the conclusion, constrained merely by private origin data restricting exact numerical overlap.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13: Queue length and occupancy for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Plots aligning downstream mainline occupancy with on-ramp queueing to assess differences in control scheme triggering.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Correlational results coherently support paper assertions regarding ALINEA parameters versus deep Q-learning, bounded by closed data access.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Grouped boxplots spanning peak and post-peak periods detailing vehicle volume distribution downstream of merging behavior to reflect capacity preservation.
nodes_sink.size_estimate: 1 panel with series over time steps
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Relies entirely upon explicit DRL simulation mechanics and reasonable metric capturing but constrained by unavailable raw empirical dataset.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16: Travel time with perturbed input data.
nodes_sink.description: A perturbation analysis represented by travel time boxplots showing system tolerance to occluded input sensor areas as mapped via simulated subareas.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure involves simple masked input retraining yielding intuitive responses; full recreation is not guaranteed due to underlying closed traffic data.
